senses.gloss:
The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots कृ 'to make' and भू 'to be', when a word ending in the affix ना -- विनञ्भ्यां नानाञौ नसह ५.२.२७, or in an affix having the force of धा -- संख्याया विधाऽर्थे धा ५.३.४२, or having the sense of the affix च्वि 'to make or to become something with it had not been before' -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः ५.४.५०, is in composition.

Terms: क्तवा and णमुल्
